_source: Age rating answers for the device-only version 0.4.0 (no server, no account, no groups). Keys are App Store Connect API AgeRatingDeclaration attribute names; .github/workflows/asc-metadata.yml sends `attributes` as they are. Re-answer when groups, a server or any SDK is added.

notSet.kidsAgeBand: Not in the Kids category; left as it is.
notSet.socialMediaAgeRestricted: Only meaningful when socialMedia is true; left as it is.
notSet.ageRatingOverrideV2: No override; Apple's calculated rating is used.
notSet.koreaAgeRatingOverride: Not distributed with a Korea-specific rating; left as it is.
